g.text: Schema: events -> seats (one row per physical seat) -> bookings, outbox for async delivery
seats carries the hold/release race; bookings is the durable record once payment succeeds
The sweeper's query is: WHERE status='held' AND hold_expires_at < NOW()
-- without this index, sweeping scans every held seat across every event on every run.
Same index also serves seats(event_id, status) for the seat-map read.
